name: Special Planning Commission Meeting
agenda_text:
CHAIRPERSON MANALO

  VICE CHAIR DIAZ | COMMISSIONER FONSECA

  COMMISSIONER BACOLOD | COMMISSIONER PALHINHA

  CITY OF ARTESIA
  SPECIAL PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING

  TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 22, 2022 | 6:30 p.m.

  LOCATION
  City Council Chambers of Artesia City Hall
  18747 Clarkdale Avenue
  (562) 865-6262

  AGENDA ITEMS

1.  Call to Order

2.  Invocation

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

4.  Roll Call of Commission

5.  Approval of Agenda

6.  Announcement of Speaker Slips

  For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item
  on the agenda, please complete a Speaker Slip located in the lobby or at the
  podium and deposit it with the Planning Manager prior to the commencement of
  the meeting. Please note that there is a five-minute time limit per speaker imposed.
  Please stay within this time limit.

7.  Consent Calendar

8.  New Business – Public Hearings

A.  Case No. 2021-06 – The Planning Commission will consider: (1) approving a
Design Review to construct a 3-story, mixed use development consisting of 4,544 square
feet of commercial space facing Arkansas Street on the ground floor and fifty-nine (59)
townhomes (including 22 live/work units) on a 2.65 acre site (within the 4.22 acre
proposed Arkansas Street Specific Plan area) contingent upon adoption of a Mitigated
Negative Declaration (MND) and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program (MMRP) ;
(2) finding General Plan conformance with vacating a portion of Alburtis Street; and, (3)

  1
 recommending approval to the City Council the following entitlements: (A) Ordinance No.
22-935 establishing the Arkansas Street Specific Plan; (B) a General Plan Amendment
to change the designation of the portion of the site from Light Manufacturing and Industrial
to Pioneer Boulevard Commercial and to add the Arkansas Street Specific Plan to
Housing Sub-Element; (C) Ordinance No. 22-936 adopting a Zoning Text and Map
Amendment to add the new Specific Plan to the list of Specific Plans in Section 9-2.3453
of Title 9 - Planning and Zoning of the Artesia Municipal Code and to change the zoning
designation of the subject site from Commercial General and Light Manufacturing and
Industrial to Arkansas Street Specific Plan; (D) a Tentative Tract Map No. 83442 to allow
the 59-unit townhouse residential development to be subdivided for condominium
purposes; and (E) adoption of a Mitigated Negative Declaration (MND) and Mitigation
Monitoring and Reporting Program (MMRP) in accordance with the California
Environmental Quality Act (CEQA).

Recommended Action:

  1.  Open and conduct a public hearing;

  2.  Adopt Resolution No. 2022-15P: A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING
  COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA RECOMMENDING THAT THE
  CITY COUNCIL APPROVE AN AMENDMENT TO THE GENERAL PLAN
  LAND USE MAP, TABLES AND TEXT TO REFLECT CHANGE IN LAND
  AREA FROM LIGHT MANUFACTURING AND INDUSTRIAL TO PIONEER
  BOULEVARD COMMERCIAL, TO ADD THE ARKANSAS STREET
  SPECIFIC PLAN TO THE TEXT OF THE GENERAL PLAN AND TO
  CHANGE THE LAND USE DESIGNATION OF PROPERTIES LOCATED
  AT 16703, 16707, PIONEER BOULEVARD, 11700, 11708, 11718, 11722,
  11728  AND  11734  ARKANSAS  STREET  FROM  LIGHT
  MANUFACTURING AND INDUSTRIAL TO PIONEER BOULEVARD
  COMMERCIAL;

  3.  Adopt Resolution No. 2022-16P: A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING
  COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA RECOMMENDING THAT THE
  CITY COUNCIL ADOPT ORDINANCE NO. 22-935 ESTABLISHING THE
  ARKANSAS STREET SPECIFIC PLAN FOR REAL PROPERTIES
  LOCATED AT 16645, 16703, 16707 PIONEER BOULEVARD AND 11700,
  11708, 11718, 11722, 11728 11734 ARKANSAS STREET (ASSESSOR
  PARCEL NUMBERS 7014-003-15 THROUGH 7014-003-028) (CASE NO.
  2021-06);

  4.  Adopt Resolution No. 2022-17P: A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING
  COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA RECOMMENDING THAT THE
  CITY COUNCIL ADOPT ORDINANCE NO. 22-936 TO APPROVE AN
  AMENDMENT TO THE CITY OF ARTESIA ZONING CODE TO
  ACKNOWLEDGE THE PROPOSED ARKANSAS STREET SPECIFIC
  PLAN AND ESTABLISH A SPECIFIC PLAN ZONE FOR THE PROPOSED

  2
   ARKANSAS STREET SPECIFIC PLAN, AND TO  APPROVE AN
  AMENDMENT TO THE CITY OF ARTESIA ZONING MAP TO CHANGE
  THE ZONING CLASSIFICATION OF REAL PROPERTY COVERED BY
  THE PROPOSED ARKANSAS STREET SPECIFIC PLAN LOCATED AT
  16645, 16703, 16707 PIONEER BOULEVARD AND 11700, 11708, 11718,
  11722, 11728 11734 ARKANSAS STREET (ASSESSOR PARCEL
  NUMBERS 7014-003-15 THROUGH 7014-003-028) FROM LIGHT
  MANUFACTURING AND INDUSTRIAL (M-1) AND GENERAL
  COMMERCIAL (C-G) ZONE TO ARKANSAS STREET SPECIFIC PLAN
  ZONE (SP 22-01) (CASE NO. 2021-06);

5.  Adopt Resolution No. 2022-18P: A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING
  COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA MAKING A FINDING OF
  GENERAL PLAN CONFORMITY REGARDING THE VACATION OF
  ALBURTIS STREET ADJACENT TO 11700 ARKANSAS STREET;

6.  Adopt Resolution No. 2022-19P: A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING
  COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA RECOMMENDING THAT THE
  CITY COUNCIL APPROVE TENTATIVE TRACT MAP NO. 83442 TO
  SUBDIVIDE THE LAND LOCATED AT 11700, 11708, 11718, 11722,
  11728, ARKANSAS STREET, 16703 PIONEER BOULEVARD AND
  PORTION OF 16707 PIONEER BOULEVARD (ASSESSOR PARCEL
  NUMBERS 7014-003-020 THROUGH 7014-003-026, 7014-003-028 AND
  PORTION OF 7014-003-027) FOR 59 RESIDENTIAL CONDOMINIUMS
  (CASE NO. 2021-06);

7.  Adopt Resolution No. 2022-20P: A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING
  COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA APPROVING A DESIGN
  REVIEW APPLICATION TO CONSTRUCT A THREE-STORY 59 UNIT
  MIXED-USE DEVELOPMENT ON PROPERTY LOCATED AT 11700,
  11708, 11718, 11722, 11728, ARKANSAS STREET, 16703 PIONEER
  BOULEVARD AND PORTION OF 16707 PIONEER BOULEVARD
  (ASSESSOR PARCEL NUMBERS 7014-003-020 THROUGH 7014-003-
  026, 7014-003-028 AND PORTION OF 7014-003-027) IN THE
  PROPOSED ARKANSAS STREET SPECIFIC PLAN (ASSP) ZONE (CASE
  NO. 2021-06) AND CONTINGENT UPON ADOPTION OF THE
  MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION (MND) AND MITIGATION
  MONITORING AND REPORTING PROGRAM (MMRP); AND,

8.  Adopt Resolution No. 2022-21P: A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING
  COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA RECOMMENDING THAT THE
  CITY COUNCIL (1) ADOPT THE MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION
  (SCH #2022090272) AND MITIGATION MONITORING AND REPORTING
  PROGRAM PURSUANT TO THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL
  QUALITY ACT (CEQA) FOR THE ARKANSAS STREET SPECIFIC PLAN

  3
   PROJECT & 11700 ARKANSAS STREET PROJECT, AND (2) APPROVE
  THE PROJECT.

9.  New Business – Non-Public Hearing (none)

10.  Discussion/Report Items from Staff (none)

11.  Items from the Commission

12.  Adjournment to the Regular Planning Commission Meeting to be held on
  Tuesday, December 20, 2022, at 6:30 p.m., in the City Council Chambers of
  Artesia City Hall at 18747 Clarkdale Avenue, Artesia.

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you
require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this
